title: Wrong person or privacy leak
effect: Wrong person or privacy leak may delay or misdirect a claim; no automated final adverse outcome is allowed.
cause: Tenant mismatch or hospital document for another member discloses medical data.
control: Authenticate before fetch; subject-match pages; regional redaction; no text logs.
detectionMethod: Audit tenant/page access and DLP canaries.
action: Privacy owner: block launch until EV2/EV11 isolate subjects and prove no raw content in prompts/logs.
metric: Unauthorized disclosures per accessed case; target 0.
kpi: R1 review touch time; safety guardrail R2
description: Hypothetical S/O/D: 1 negligible/rare/pre-harm detection to 10 catastrophic/frequent/undetected. Scores prioritize work; they are not measured probabilities.
reasoning: Keeps evidence, authority and recovery explicit.
sources: [{"type":"context","file":"user-brief","passage":"Design a health insurance claim adjudication assistant for inpatient hospital claims. It should read submitted policy and hospital documents, assess coverage and eligible charges, recommend or process eligible claims, and route exceptions and rejections for review. Policies can change over time and bills may include room-rent limits. Protect personal medical data, explain decisions with evidence and propose any missing rules as assumptions, not verified insurance or medical advice."},{"type":"hypothesis","file":"H1","passage":"First release creates review packets only. Claims staff approve all eligible recommendations, exceptions and rejection candidates; no settlement, denial notice or payment is automated."}]

title: Room limit and maths error
effect: Room limit and maths error may delay or misdirect a claim; no automated final adverse outcome is allowed.
cause: Unapproved blanket proration or wrong rounding reduces eligible charges.
control: Explicit charge-class rules and integer minor-unit arithmetic; missing rules means review. Approved formula ID, line class and once-only floor proration; unsupported policy routes review.
detectionMethod: Exact line calculation and one-minor-unit boundary replay.
action: Policy owner: sign synthetic arithmetic contract and pass EV1/EV4/EV13 before launch. Also require EV21-EV23 proration branch suite.
metric: Incorrect charge totals / verified bills; target 0.
kpi: R1 review touch time; safety guardrail R2

title: Injected or contradictory evidence

control: Treat all pages as data; citations/schema; model facts never trusted; ambiguity routes staff. Visible-page OCR only; exact source span and applicable-clause code validation before save.
detectionMethod: Adversarial page suite and sampled citation adjudication.
action: ML lead: pass EV5/EV14 and held-out review before release. Also require EV24-EV27 citation/layer suite.
metric: Unsupported recommendations / reviewed packets; target <=1% hypothesis.

title: Review queue stalls

detectionMethod: Queue assignment proof, simulated overdue and cancellation test.
action: Claims lead: approve H5, staff queue, pass EV15 before launch; stop intake if unowned queue item exists.
metric: Unowned packets and overdue acknowledgement rate; targets 0 and <5% hypothesis.
